name: sqlite_phase12_verified
purpose: Curated regression data for the complete SQLite Phase1+Phase2 diagnostic pipeline; this is not an unbiased effectiveness benchmark.

criteria: cover every Phase1 operator family represented by the generated source
cover one or two distinct exact-primary examples for each currently verified teaching rule
include twelve native-SQLite public-reference cases with synthetic student mutations
require prior witness, repair, and hint-safety verification for diagnostic cases

known_rule_exclusions.S1_MISSING_BRIDGE: candidate detected but not reliably ranked as primary
known_rule_exclusions.S5_FANOUT_AGGREGATE: no distinguishing witness in the targeted matrix
